purpose: Keep three-session factor research moving during Candidate49 prospective observation by preparing an economically differentiated mechanism-only queue without activating Candidate50, freezing another formula, computing another candidate value, or reading any price or return outcome.

future_only_policy.candidate50_activation_condition: candidate49 is terminally rejected or completes its full 200-signal evaluation

queue_semantics.required_next_step_for_one_entry: After Candidate49 satisfies the activation condition, choose only the first still-distinct entry, perform a fresh mechanism-overlap audit, and freeze one exact formula and direction before any candidate values.

inactive_priority_queue.mechanism: Remove each stock's contemporaneous leave-one-out equal-weight market component from the 238 within-half one-minute log returns, then measure signed firm-specific drift concentrated in the final sixty afternoon return positions relative to total absolute residual movement.
inactive_priority_queue.nonbinding_formula_sketch: Estimate beta_i from the same completed signal session using r_i,t versus leave-one-out market r_m,t over 238 within-half returns; epsilon_i,t=r_i,t-beta_i*r_m,t; score=sum(epsilon_i,t over the final 60 afternoon return positions)/sum(abs(epsilon_i,t) over all 238 positions).
inactive_priority_queue.economic_hypothesis: Positive late firm-specific repricing that survives removal of the broad intraday market path may persist from the next open through the third close.
inactive_priority_queue.expected_distinction: Unlike market idiosyncratic share, this is signed and late-path directional rather than one minus market R-squared; unlike Candidate49, it uses market-neutral residual drift rather than crossings around a cumulative own-stock VWAP.
known_design_risks: zero or near-zero leave-one-out market variance
late-window overlap with retired late-return mechanisms

inactive_priority_queue.mechanism: Measure the CNY-weighted fraction of negative within-half minute returns that are immediately followed by a positive return, using 236 adjacent return pairs and excluding the lunch transition.
inactive_priority_queue.nonbinding_formula_sketch: For each of the 236 within-half adjacent return pairs (r_t,r_t+1), weight a negative r_t by the amount on its destination bar; score=sum(weight_t*1[r_t<0 and r_t+1>0])/sum(weight_t*1[r_t<0]).
inactive_priority_queue.economic_hypothesis: Frequent amount-backed recovery immediately after selling pressure may indicate short-horizon liquidity absorption that remains relevant over the next three sessions.
inactive_priority_queue.expected_distinction: Unlike sign-run imbalance, it isolates negative-to-positive transitions and weights the initiating sell interval by CNY amount; unlike afternoon drawdown recovery, it measures repeated local full-day absorption rather than one maximum afternoon drawdown.
known_design_risks: few or no negative-return denominator events

inactive_priority_queue.mechanism: Compare the signed net continuous-session close displacement with the total absolute close-path travel across the exact 240 positions.
inactive_priority_queue.nonbinding_formula_sketch: score=log(close_240/close_1)/sum(abs(log(close_t/close_t-1)), t=2..240), with the lunch gap collapsed exactly as in the joint-clean sequence.
inactive_priority_queue.economic_hypothesis: A close path that travels efficiently upward rather than oscillating may reflect persistent demand into a three-session horizon.
inactive_priority_queue.expected_distinction: It is a signed path-length efficiency ratio rather than a terminal range location, raw return-sign run count, or amount-weighted pressure measure.
known_design_risks: likely high rank overlap with terminal location and return-sign mechanisms

accepted_uses: future t_plus_1 open and t_plus_3 close paper settlement
tushare_daily_role_during_candidate49.reason: The active frozen policy permits only one new mechanism and currently assigns that slot to Candidate49; opening a daily candidate now would violate multiplicity control.
tushare_daily_role_during_candidate49.future_daily_track_option: After Candidate49 satisfies its activation condition, a separately frozen prospective daily-factor policy may be considered without reusing the exhausted historical return history.

research_boundary.files_read_for_this_record: mechanism descriptions and frozen policy/state only

decision.next_action_before_candidate49_terminal_: Continue Candidate49 prospective collection and paper settlement only; maintain this queue without computing its values.
decision.next_action_after_activation_condition: Review priority one for exact economic overlap. If it remains distinct, create one new immutable mechanism audit and no-return preregistration before any value computation; otherwise retire it without values and inspect priority two.
